cr_data.provenance: Cary Ross, New York, NY, gift, 1932; (Alfred Stieglitz, New York, NY), return, 1940; The artist, 1946; (Doris Bry, New York, NY); Dr. Milton Gardner, Merrick, New York, exchange, 1971; (Hirschl & Adler Galleries, Inc., New York, NY) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946 . . . [notes backing inscription]. Probably in 1932 exh. (for which we have no catalogue) & ptd. 1931." Backing inscription dates 1932. Whitney Archive dates 1930? Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1931. Gift to Ross confirmed in Stieglitz to CR, YCAL MSS 85 No. 42, Folder 1009. Exchanged in 1971 for cat. no. 204. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.

description: Rippling purple, pink, and silver forms flow across the composition like waves of slippery fabric. The smooth forms glow bright white at the bottom of the image.
